bullets: • SBI Small Cap Fund carries an exit load of 1.0%, meaning investors are charged 1% of the redemption amount if units are redeemed before the applicable exit load period, as of 2026-05-05.

• SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund has an exit load of 0%, so no exit load fee is charged upon redemption; however, it enforces a mandatory 3-year lock-in period during which redemption is not permitted, as of 2026-04-24.
• SBI Large Cap Fund (Bluechip) has a relatively lower exit load of 0.2%, making it the lowest exit load among the non-ELSS equity funds listed in this context, as of 2026-04-24.

• SBI Focused Equity Fund charges an exit load of 1% if units are redeemed within 1 year from the date of allotment; redemptions made after 1 year are not subject to this exit load fee, as of 2026-05-05.
• Among the four funds listed, exit loads range from 0% (SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund) to 1.0% (SBI Small Cap Fund and SBI Focused Equity Fund), reflecting varying fee structures across fund categories.
• Exit load fees are deducted from the redemption proceeds at the time of transaction and are separate from the expense ratio, which ranges from 0.79% to 0.99% across these funds.
